messages:
anya: Heads up: client 'Marlin' onboarding hit a spike of 429s + subsequent 401s after switching to our node SDK. Started at ~13:04 UTC when they ramped tests.
raj: Do we have logs/snippets from their side? Which SDK version?
anya: redwood-node 0.7.1. Customer pasted this: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: mar-9001
{"error":"rate_limited"}
...followed by...
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-request-id: mar-9002
{"error":"invalid_client"}
```
mike: Classic preflight fanout -> gateway backpressure -> auth jitter. Are they prefetching ephemeral tokens per request?
anya: Yes, they preflight before every connection and run parallel workers (~250). Ephemeral TTL is 45s.
raj: Short TTL + high concurrency can cause tokens to expire between preflight and actual use. Also gateway queuing under 429s can surface auth errors. Short-term: recommend bumping TTL to 180s during onboarding and reduce parallel preflights (coalesce to a pool).
mike: I can temporarily lift tenant rate-limits for Marlin for 20m while they test. That should let us separate auth vs rate-limit effects. Want me to proceed?
anya: Please do. Also ask them to add jitter and a single shared token per worker instead of per-request preflight.
raj: I'll draft a quick KB snippet and a small Node code sample for token pooling + exponential backoff. Suggest adding to onboarding checklist: set ephemeral TTL >= 120s and cap preflight concurrency under 50.
support-bot: Applied temporary rate-limit relaxation for tenant marlin (20 minutes). Created ticket CS-9112 for follow-up.
anya: Customer updated: after TTL=180s + pooling, errors dropped to near-zero in the next 10m. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
raj: Long-term: we should add client-side preflight coalescing to the SDK and a docs note about TTL/concurrency. Filing a feature request.
mike: Filing FR-345 (SDK token pool + debounce).
anya: Closing loop with customer; will include the KB link and recommended settings. Thanks all.
